mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: seeing nerves and blood routes reach the same muscles tied different systems together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the repaired segment into the covering felt a little repetitive after preparing the other regions, though the scar was a useful reminder of the repair.

surprise.text: The diaphragm separating the chest from the abdomen helped me picture how the regions fit together, with routes crossing between them.

arbitrary.text: The lymph network fitting into the breathing apparatus was less obvious from the names alone. The result clarified that its existing junction aligns with a neck vein.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored a new connection, though more straightforward regional fittings alone might feel repetitive.
